summary: Frontend-only SWR cache test for /asi-bot creds+balance page-cache fix. PASS: with network artificially delayed 4s (simulating the user's slow-fetch scenario), a hard reload rendered the cached connected state on FIRST PAINT (t=0.61s after reload): Binance Futures row showed 'TESTNET ✓ · ****AB12' and balance cards showed $123.45 (DEMO) / $678.90 (REAL) — not 'Not connected'. After the delayed refresh landed, state correctly flipped back to backend truth ('Not connected' for the synthetic deviceId) — expected SWR overwrite, not a bug. Regression PASS: zero console errors, no panic banner text, mode chips (Semi/Full-Auto) work and persist to @asi_bot_prefs.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: consider adding a TTL/max-age to readPageCache entries (currently stale cache has no expiry bound, though refresh always overwrites on success).
critical_code_review_comments: asi-bot.tsx:140-145 — cache restore is awaited BEFORE refresh(did) in the mount effect, so first paint always reflects cache; correct SWR ordering.
pageCache.ts — readPageCache/writePageCache are fail-safe (never throw); key format 'pagecache:v1:{name}:{deviceId}' matches AsyncStorage-on-web localStorage 1:1.
Empty creds cache ([]) written by refresh is correctly ignored on restore via length>0 check — good.

Note for future testers: page.add_init_script localStorage seeding did NOT persist in this Playwright environment (test artifact). Working method: load page once, read 'cryptostock.device_fingerprint', seed pagecache keys via page.evaluate, then page.reload() and capture first paint.
seed_data_creation: localStorage-only test data: pagecache:v1:asibot-creds:{deviceId} (Binance testnet cred, mask ****AB12) and pagecache:v1:asibot-balance:{deviceId} (demo $123.45, real $678.90) seeded in the preview browser context only; no backend/DB data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test SWR first-paint on /asi-bot: (1) goto page, read localStorage 'cryptostock.device_fingerprint'; (2) page.evaluate to seed 'pagecache:v1:asibot-creds:{did}' and 'pagecache:v1:asibot-balance:{did}' with {at, data} JSON; (3) page.route('**/api/asi/**') with a 3-4s delay to simulate slow network; (4) page.reload() and poll #root innerText from first text — cached mask/balances must appear before delayed refresh returns. Refresh afterwards legitimately overwrites with backend truth. Dev bypass: no login needed on preview.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: balance DEMO/REAL cards and exchange connection status reset to 'Not connected' on every page re-entry because state initialized empty and only network refresh populated it. Fix verified: creds/balance now restored from AsyncStorage page cache (stale-while-revalidate) on mount before refresh() runs; confirmed via delayed-network test where cached state rendered at first paint (0.61s) vs refresh at ~4s.
